title: Uniform amplitude on the constructible Serre coproduct closure over a Noetherian base
statement: Fix universes u and u+1, a prime ell, a field k in universe u with ringChar(k) different from ell, schemes Z,Y in universe u, a morphism aY:Y→Spec(k), a Noetherian Y, and a proper p:Z→Y. Let Λ be a commutative condensed ring object, with its specified multiplication, having IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ell Λ: a finite normed Q_ell extension, the induced ring of integers of a finite embedded extension, the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure, or the closed unit ball of a finite normed extension. Put Λ_T=p_T^*Λ and D_T=D(Mod(Λ_T)), with the actual total right derived functor Rp_* [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Constructibility means stratified local finite presentation [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. The coefficient certification is the four-constructor class in WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.RingObjects.Condensed.FinitenessCoefficient, with its monoid-object index, rather than a new coefficient construction. Let P_Z be the least replete class of Λ_Z-module objects containing the constructible modules and closed under kernels, cokernels, extensions and coproducts indexed in universe u+1. There exists an integer d such that for every M in P_Z, Rp_*(M[0]) has zero cohomology in all degrees greater than d. The bound is independent of M. No finite-type or separatedness assumption is imposed on aY, and k may have characteristic zero.

source.place: The amplitude clause, and the final passage from constructible sheaves to their filtered colimits; proper Noetherian specialization of Bhatt--Scholze 6.7.2 and 6.8.15.

proof.text: Y is Noetherian and p is proper, so Z is Noetherian and p is quasi-compact of finite type. [lem-fin-finite-type-fibre-dimension-bound] bounds the dimensions of all fibres of p by one natural number d. Invariance of the dimension of a finite-type scheme under the field extension from the residue field to its algebraic closure [lem-sf-field-extension-dimension-upper-bound] turns this into the same bound d for every geometric fibre.

Constructible bound for a finite embedded integral model O_F. Apply [lem-sfb-integral-proper-constructible-heart-bound] in its Noetherian form: its base field is used only to make the source Noetherian. Derived completeness of the image comes from the integral direct-image limits and the residue criterion, and the finite reductions have the proper torsion bound 2d by [lem-sfb-integral-proper-reduction-bound] over a Noetherian source. Milnor gives Rp_*(N[0]) in degrees at most 2d+1 for every constructible N.

Constructible bound for a finite embedded field F and for the finite-subextension-valued Qbar. Apply both clauses of [det-proper-heart-bound-rational] in their Noetherian form: an F-constructible module is the localization of a glued integral model, and a Qbar-constructible module descends to a finite field by [det-lem-coefficient-finite-descent-objects] over a Noetherian scheme. Both give vanishing of R^q p_* above 2d+1 for constructible inputs.

The weak Serre coproduct closure lies in the ind-constructibles. For F and Qbar: finite presentation and essential smallness give canonical presentations; the kernel/cokernel comparison, extension closure and finite-subcoproduct presentations give all closure operations. For O_F: [lem-sfb-integral-ind-heart-closure] over a Noetherian scheme, whose Ext continuity is [det-lem-int-ext-continuity] over a Noetherian scheme. Minimality of the closure and the constructibility comparison conclude.

Represent a closure object by a small filtered diagram of constructibles. Single followed by derived pushforward and cohomology preserves filtered colimits by the bounded-below qcqs comparison. All stages vanish above 2d+1, so the colimit does. This gives the bound 2d+1 for the three model coefficients.

Construct a finite embedded field model by taking the range of an algebra embedding into PadicAlgCl. Uniqueness of the norm makes it isometric. Restrict to the specified unit ball and postcompose continuous sections to construct the coefficient isomorphism. Exact inverse scalar restriction preserves constructibility and the weak Serre coproduct closure. Derived pushforward and degree-zero comparisons transport the bound; faithful exact restriction reflects it. The arbitrary embedded integral constructor uses its induced norm.

proof_origin.place: L, 2026-10-25 (coord/changes/L-weak-serre-detour-reroute.md): the blueprint route of sk-lem-proper-heart-bound (torsion bound 2d, Milnor 2d+1, rationalization and Qbar, filtered colimits), run over a Noetherian base. The earlier qcqs weak-Serre / torsion-cd detour is no longer used.

theorem properLowerStar_uniformBound_ellAdic
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [IsEllAdicFinitenessCoefficient ℓ Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsNoetherian Y]
    (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p] :
    ∃ d : ℤ, ∀ M, constructibleCoproductClosure Λ Z M →
      (R((p)_*⟦Λ⟧).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)).IsLE d
